title: Small Soldiers
tagline: Toys at war. Snacks at peace.
about: Action figures fitted with military chips come to life and go to war in a quiet Ohio town.

    StartersInner Child toy shop popcornButtered popcorn with sprinkles, chocolate buttons and pretzel piecesHow to make it100g popping corn60g butter, melted3 tbsp sprinkles1 cup chocolate buttons1 cup broken pretzel piecesPop the corn and toss with the melted butter.Add the sprinkles while the butter is warm so they stick.Stir in the chocolate buttons and pretzel pieces and tip into a bowl like a toy box.Gorgonite pumpkin feta filo trianglesRoast pumpkin, feta and sage in crisp buttered filoHow to make it400g butternut pumpkin, diced150g feta, crumbled1 tbsp chopped sage1 packet filo pastry100g butter, meltedRoast the pumpkin at 200°C until soft, then mash with the feta and sage.Cut buttered filo into strips, spoon the filling at one end and fold into triangles.Brush with butter and bake at 190°C until golden.Chip Hazard's salami ration crackersSalami crackers, mobile and lethileHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crackers lined up in rows like troops, topped with sharp cheddar, crisped salami, a slice of pickle and a dab of hot honey mustard.Lay 16 slices of salami on a lined tray and bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool.Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp mild mustard.Top 16 crackers with a slice of sharp cheddar, a piece of crisp salami and a round of dill pickle.Add a dab of the honey mustard and line them up on a board in neat army rows.MainsOhio barbecue ribs with corn and slawFoil-baked paprika pork ribs finished over coals, grilled corn, coleslawHow to make it1.5kg pork ribs2 tbsp smoked paprika100g brown sugar1 tsp salt150ml barbecue sauce4 corn cobs1/4 small cabbage, shredded1 carrot, grated3 tbsp mayonnaiseRub the ribs with the paprika, sugar and salt, then wrap in foil.Bake at 150°C for 3 hours.Brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.Grill the corn. Toss the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a crunchy coleslaw.Power pole last stand chicken burgersFried chicken burger, Alan's house under siegeHow to make it4 chicken thigh fillets200ml buttermilk150g plain flour1 tsp smoked paprika500ml vegetable oil4 burger buns1 iceberg lettuce2 tomatoes100g dill pickles4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp tomato sauce1 tsp hot sauceSoak the chicken in the buttermilk with salt for at least 15 minutes.Toss in the flour mixed with the paprika and fry in the oil at 170°C for 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and hot sauce for the comeback sauce.Toast the buns and fill with lettuce, tomato, chicken, pickles and sauce.SweetsArmy green peppermint squaresCookie crumb base, green peppermint icing and dark chocolate on topHow to make it250g sweet biscuits, crushed150g butter, melted, plus a little extra300g icing sugar1 tsp peppermint essence1 tsp green food colouring200g dark chocolate, meltedMix the biscuits with most of the butter and press into a lined tin.Beat the icing sugar with a little butter, peppermint and green colouring and spread over.Pour the melted chocolate on top and chill until set.Cut into small squares.DrinksCommando Elite lime and mint fizzLime, mint and sugar syrup topped with soda water, served in camping mugsHow to make it100g caster sugar100ml hot water1 cup mint leaves, plus 4 sprigs6 limes, 5 juiced and 1 sliced1 L cold soda water1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Muddle the mint leaves with the syrup in a jug. Add the lime juice and plenty of ice.Top with soda water and stir. Pour into four mugs with a lime wheel and mint sprig.
